[1049](#1049)                    indices.load(&mut store, instance)
[1050](#1050)                }}
[1051](#1051)            ",
[1052](#1052)        );
[1053](#1053)        self.world_add_to_linker(resolve, world, world_trait.as_ref());
[1054](#1054)
[1055](#1055)        for func in self.exports.funcs.iter() {
[1056](#1056)            self.src.push_str(func);
[1057](#1057)        }
[1058](#1058)
[1059](#1059)        uwriteln!(self.src, "}}"); uwriteln!(self.src, "}};"); }
[1063](#1063)
[1064](#1064)    fn finish(&mut self, resolve: &Resolve, world: WorldId) -> anyhow::Result<String> {
[1065](#1065)        let remapping_keys = self.opts.with.keys().cloned().collect::<HashSet<String>>();
[1066](#1066)
[1067](#1067)        let mut unused_keys = remapping_keys
[1068](#1068)            .difference(&self.used_with_opts)
[1069](#1069)            .map(|s| s.as_str())
[1070](#1070)            .collect::<Vec<&str>>();
[1071](#1071)
[1072](#1072)        unused_keys.sort();
[1073](#1073)
[1074](#1074)        if !unused_keys.is_empty() {
[1075](#1075)            anyhow::bail!(
[1076](#1076)                "interfaces were specified in the `with` config option but are not referenced in the target world: {unused_keys:?}"
[1077](#1077)            );
[1078](#1078)        }
[1079](#1079)
[1080](#1080)        if !self.opts.only_interfaces {
[1081](#1081)            self.build_world_struct(resolve, world)
[1082](#1082)        }
[1083](#1083)
[1084](#1084)        if let TrappableImports::Only(only) = &self.opts.trappable_imports {
[1085](#1085)            let mut unused_imports = Vec::from_iter(
[1086](#1086)                only.difference(&self.used_trappable_imports_opts)
[1087](#1087)                    .map(|s| s.as_str()),
[1088](#1088)            );
[1089](#1089)
[1090](#1090)            if !unused_imports.is_empty() {
[1091](#1091)                unused_imports.sort();
[1092](#1092)                anyhow::bail!(
[1093](#1093)                    "names specified in the `trappable_imports` config option but are not referenced in the target world: {unused_imports:?}"
[1094](#1094)                );
[1095](#1095)            }
[1096](#1096)        }
[1097](#1097)
[1098](#1098)        let imports = mem::take(&mut self.import_interfaces);
[1099](#1099)        self.emit_modules(
[1100](#1100)            imports
[1101](#1101)                .into_iter()
[1102](#1102)                .map(|(_, id, module, path)| (id, module, path))
[1103](#1103)                .collect(),
[1104](#1104)        );
[1105](#1105)
[1106](#1106)        let exports = mem::take(&mut self.exports.modules);
[1107](#1107)        self.emit_modules(exports);
[1108](#1108)
[1109](#1109)        let mut src = mem::take(&mut self.src);
[1110](#1110)        if self.opts.rustfmt {
[1111](#1111)            let mut child = Command::new("rustfmt")
[1112](#1112)                .arg("--edition=2018")
[1113](#1113)                .stdin(Stdio::piped())
[1114](#1114)                .stdout(Stdio::piped())
[1115](#1115)                .spawn()
[1116](#1116)                .expect("failed to spawn `rustfmt`");
[1117](#1117)            child
[1118](#1118)                .stdin
[1119](#1119)                .take()
[1120](#1120)                .unwrap()
[1121](#1121)                .write_all(src.as_bytes())
[1122](#1122)                .unwrap();
[1123](#1123)            src.as_mut_string().truncate(0);
[1124](#1124)            child
[1125](#1125)                .stdout
[1126](#1126)                .take()
[1127](#1127)                .unwrap()
[1128](#1128)                .read_to_string(src.as_mut_string())
[1129](#1129)                .unwrap();
[1130](#1130)            let status = child.wait().unwrap();
[1131](#1131)            assert!(status.success());
[1132](#1132)        }
[1133](#1133)
[1134](#1134)        Ok(src.into())
[1135](#1135)    }
[1136](#1136)
[1137](#1137)    fn emit_modules(&mut self, modules: Vec<(InterfaceId, String, InterfaceName)>) {
[1138](#1138)        #[derive(Default)]
[1139](#1139)        struct Module {
[1140](#1140)            submodules: BTreeMap<String, Module>,
[1141](#1141)            contents: Vec<String>,
[1142](#1142)        }
[1143](#1143)        let mut map = Module::default();
[1144](#1144)        for (_, module, name) in modules {
[1145](#1145)            let path = match name {
[1146](#1146)                InterfaceName::Remapped { local_path, .. } => local_path,
[1147](#1147)                InterfaceName::Path(path) => path,
[1148](#1148)            };
[1149](#1149)            let mut cur = &mut map;
[1150](#1150)            for name in path[..path.len() - 1].iter() {
[1151](#1151)                cur = cur
[1152](#1152)                    .submodules
[1153](#1153)                    .entry(name.clone())
[1154](#1154)                    .or_insert(Module::default());
[1155](#1155)            }
[1156](#1156)            cur.contents.push(module);
[1157](#1157)        }
[1158](#1158)
[1159](#1159)        emit(&mut self.src, map);
[1160](#1160)
[1161](#1161)        fn emit(me: &mut Source, module: Module) {
[1162](#1162)            for (name, submodule) in module.submodules {
[1163](#1163)                uwriteln!(me, "pub mod {name} {{");
[1164](#1164)                emit(me, submodule);
[1165](#1165)                uwriteln!(me, "}}");
[1166](#1166)            }
[1167](#1167)            for submodule in module.contents {
[1168](#1168)                uwriteln!(me, "{submodule}");
[1169](#1169)            }
[1170](#1170)        }
[1171](#1171)    }
[1172](#1172)
[1173](#1173)    fn lookup_replacement(
[1176](#1176)        &mut self,
[1177](#1177)        resolve: &Resolve,
[1178](#1178)        key: &WorldKey,
[1179](#1179)        item: Option<&str>,
[1180](#1180)    ) -> Option<String> {
[1181](#1181)        let item = match item {
[1182](#1182)            Some(item) => LookupItem::Name(item),
[1183](#1183)            None => LookupItem::None,
[1184](#1184)        };
[1185](#1185)
[1186](#1186)        for (lookup, mut projection) in lookup_keys(resolve, key, item) {
[1187](#1187)            if let Some(renamed) = self.opts.with.get(&lookup) {
[1188](#1188)                projection.push(renamed.clone());
[1189](#1189)                projection.reverse();
[1190](#1190)                self.used_with_opts.insert(lookup);
[1191](#1191)                return Some(projection.join("::"));
[1192](#1192)            }
[1193](#1193)        }
[1194](#1194)
[1195](#1195)        None
[1196](#1196)    }
[1197](#1197)
[1198](#1198)    fn wasmtime_path(&self) -> String {
[1199](#1199)        self.opts
[1200](#1200)            .wasmtime_crate
[1201](#1201)            .clone()
[1202](#1202)            .unwrap_or("wasmtime".to_string())
[1203](#1203)    }
[1204](#1204)}
[1205](#1205)
[1206](#1206)enum LookupItem<'a> {
[1207](#1207)    None,
[1208](#1208)    Name(&'a str),
[1209](#1209)    InterfaceNoPop,
[1210](#1210)}
[1211](#1211)
[1212](#1212)fn lookup_keys(
[1213](#1213)    resolve: &Resolve,
[1214](#1214)    key: &WorldKey,
[1215](#1215)    item: LookupItem<'_>,
[1216](#1216)) -> Vec<(String, Vec<String>)> {
[1217](#1217)    struct Name<'a> {
[1218](#1218)        prefix: Prefix,
[1219](#1219)        item: Option<&'a str>,
[1220](#1220)    }
[1221](#1221)
[1222](#1222)    #[derive(Copy, Clone)]
[1223](#1223)    enum Prefix {
[1224](#1224)        Namespace(PackageId),
[1225](#1225)        UnversionedPackage(PackageId),
[1226](#1226)        VersionedPackage(PackageId),
[1227](#1227)        UnversionedInterface(InterfaceId),
[1228](#1228)        VersionedInterface(InterfaceId),
[1229](#1229)    }
[1230](#1230)
[1231](#1231)    let prefix = match key {
[1232](#1232)        WorldKey::Interface(id) => Prefix::VersionedInterface(*id),
[1233](#1233)
[1234](#1234)        WorldKey::Name(key) => {
[1237](#1237)            let to_lookup = match item {
[1238](#1238)                LookupItem::Name(item) => format!("{key}/{item}"),
[1239](#1239)                LookupItem::None | LookupItem::InterfaceNoPop => key.to_string(),
[1240](#1240)            };
[1241](#1241)            return vec![(to_lookup, Vec::new())];
[1242](#1242)        }
[1243](#1243)    };
[1244](#1244)
[1245](#1245)    let (interface_required, item) = match item {
[1255](#1255)        LookupItem::None => (false, None),
[1256](#1256)        LookupItem::Name(s) => (false, Some(s)),
[1257](#1257)        LookupItem::InterfaceNoPop => (true, None),
[1258](#1258)    };
[1259](#1259)    let mut name = Name { prefix, item };
[1260](#1260)    let mut projection = Vec::new();
[1261](#1261)    let mut ret = Vec::new();
[1262](#1262)    loop {
[1263](#1263)        let lookup = name.lookup_key(resolve);
[1264](#1264)        ret.push((lookup, projection.clone()));
[1265](#1265)        if !name.pop(resolve, &mut projection) {
[1266](#1266)            break;
[1267](#1267)        }
[1268](#1268)        if interface_required {
[1269](#1269)            match name.prefix {
[1270](#1270)                Prefix::VersionedInterface(_) | Prefix::UnversionedInterface(_) => {}
[1271](#1271)                _ => break,
[1272](#1272)            }
[1273](#1273)        }
[1274](#1274)    }
[1275](#1275)
[1276](#1276)    return ret;
[1277](#1277)
[1278](#1278)    impl<'a> Name<'a> {
[1279](#1279)        fn lookup_key(&self, resolve: &Resolve) -> String {
[1280](#1280)            let mut s = self.prefix.lookup_key(resolve);
[1281](#1281)            if let Some(item) = self.item {
[1282](#1282)                s.push_str("/");
[1283](#1283)                s.push_str(item);
[1284](#1284)            }
[1285](#1285)            s
[1286](#1286)        }
[1287](#1287)
[1288](#1288)        fn pop(&mut self, resolve: &'a Resolve, projection: &mut Vec<String>) -> bool {
[1289](#1289)            match (self.item, self.prefix) {
[1290](#1290)                (Some(_), Prefix::VersionedInterface(id)) => {
[1293](#1293)                    self.prefix = Prefix::UnversionedInterface(id);
[1294](#1294)                    true
[1295](#1295)                }
[1296](#1296)                (Some(item), Prefix::UnversionedInterface(id)) => {
[1300](#1300)                    self.prefix = Prefix::VersionedInterface(id);
[1301](#1301)                    self.item = None;
[1302](#1302)                    projection.push(item.to_upper_camel_case());
[1303](#1303)                    true
[1304](#1304)                }
[1305](#1305)                (Some(_), _) => unreachable!(),
[1306](#1306)                (None, _) => self.prefix.pop(resolve, projection),
[1307](#1307)            }
[1308](#1308)        }
[1309](#1309)    }
[1310](#1310)
[1311](#1311)    impl Prefix {
[1312](#1312)        fn lookup_key(&self, resolve: &Resolve) -> String {
[1313](#1313)            match *self {
[1314](#1314)                Prefix::Namespace(id) => resolve.packages[id].name.namespace.clone(),
[1315](#1315)                Prefix::UnversionedPackage(id) => {
[1316](#1316)                    let mut name = resolve.packages[id].name.clone();
[1317](#1317)                    name.version = None;
[1318](#1318)                    name.to_string()
[1319](#1319)                }
[1320](#1320)                Prefix::VersionedPackage(id) => resolve.packages[id].name.to_string(),
[1321](#1321)                Prefix::UnversionedInterface(id) => {
[1322](#1322)                    let id = resolve.id_of(id).unwrap();
[1323](#1323)                    match id.find('@') {
[1324](#1324)                        Some(i) => id[..i].to_string(),
[1325](#1325)                        None => id,
[1326](#1326)                    }
[1327](#1327)                }
[1328](#1328)                Prefix::VersionedInterface(id) => resolve.id_of(id).unwrap(),
[1329](#1329)            }
[1330](#1330)        }
[1331](#1331)
[1332](#1332)        fn pop(&mut self, resolve: &Resolve, projection: &mut Vec<String>) -> bool {
[1333](#1333)            *self = match *self {
[1334](#1334)                Prefix::VersionedInterface(id) => Prefix::UnversionedInterface(id),
[1336](#1336)                Prefix::UnversionedInterface(id) => {
[1338](#1338)                    let iface = &resolve.interfaces[id];
[1339](#1339)                    let name = iface.name.as_ref().unwrap();
[1340](#1340)                    projection.push(to_rust_ident(name));
[1341](#1341)                    Prefix::VersionedPackage(iface.package.unwrap())
[1342](#1342)                }
[1343](#1343)                Prefix::VersionedPackage(id) => Prefix::UnversionedPackage(id),
[1345](#1345)                Prefix::UnversionedPackage(id) => {
[1347](#1347)                    let name = &resolve.packages[id].name;
[1348](#1348)                    projection.push(to_rust_ident(&name.name));
[1349](#1349)                    Prefix::Namespace(id)
[1350](#1350)                }
[1351](#1351)                Prefix::Namespace(_) => return false,
[1353](#1353)            };
[1354](#1354)            true
[1355](#1355)        }
[1356](#1356)    }
[1357](#1357)}
[1358](#1358)
[1359](#1359)impl Wasmtime {
[1360](#1360)    fn has_world_imports_trait(&self, resolve: &Resolve, world: WorldId) -> bool {
[1361](#1361)        !self.import_functions.is_empty() || get_world_resources(resolve, world).count() > 0
[1362](#1362)    }
[1363](#1363)
[1364](#1364)    fn world_imports_trait(&mut self, resolve: &Resolve, world: WorldId) -> Option<GeneratedTrait> {
[1365](#1365)        if !self.has_world_imports_trait(resolve, world) {
[1366](#1366)            return None;
[1367](#1367)        }
[1368](#1368)
[1369](#1369)        let world_camel = to_rust_upper_camel_case(&resolve.worlds[world].name);
[1370](#1370)
[1371](#1371)        let functions = self.import_functions.clone();
[1372](#1372)        let mut generator = InterfaceGenerator::new(self, resolve);
[1373](#1373)        let generated_trait = generator.generate_trait(
[1374](#1374)            &format!("{world_camel}Imports"),
[1375](#1375)            &functions
[1376](#1376)                .iter()
[1377](#1377)                .filter(|f| f.kind.resource().is_none())
[1378](#1378)                .collect::<Vec<_>>(),
[1379](#1379)            &[],
[1380](#1380)            &get_world_resources(resolve, world).collect::<Vec<_>>(),
[1381](#1381)        );
[1382](#1382)        let src = String::from(mem::take(&mut generator.src));
[1383](#1383)        self.src.push_str(&src);
[1384](#1384)        Some(generated_trait)
[1385](#1385)    }
[1386](#1386)
[1387](#1387)    fn import_interface_paths(&self) -> Vec<(InterfaceId, String)> {
[1388](#1388)        self.import_interfaces
[1389](#1389)            .iter()
[1390](#1390)            .map(|(_, id, _, name)| {
[1391](#1391)                let path = match name {
[1392](#1392)                    InterfaceName::Path(path) => path.join("::"),
[1393](#1393)                    InterfaceName::Remapped { name_at_root, .. } => name_at_root.clone(),
[1394](#1394)                };
[1395](#1395)                (*id, path)
[1396](#1396)            })
[1397](#1397)            .collect()
[1398](#1398)    }
[1399](#1399)
[1400](#1400)    fn import_interface_path(&self, id: &InterfaceId) -> String {
[1401](#1401)        match &self.interface_names[id] {
[1402](#1402)            InterfaceName::Path(path) => path.join("::"),
[1403](#1403)            InterfaceName::Remapped { name_at_root, .. } => name_at_root.clone(),
[1404](#1404)        }
[1405](#1405)    }
[1406](#1406)
[1407](#1407)    fn import_interface_any_concurrent(&self, resolve: &Resolve, id: InterfaceId) -> bool {
[1408](#1408)        for (key, id2, ..) in self.import_interfaces.iter() {
[1409](#1409)            if id != *id2 {
[1410](#1410)                continue;
[1411](#1411)            }
[1412](#1412)
[1413](#1413)            let key = resolve.name_world_key(key);
[1414](#1414)            return resolve.interfaces[id].functions.iter().any(|(name, _)| {
[1415](#1415)                self.opts.import_call_style(Some(&key), name) == CallStyle::Concurrent
[1416](#1416)            });
[1417](#1417)        }
[1418](#1418)        unreachable!()
[1419](#1419)    }
[1420](#1420)
[1421](#1421)    fn world_host_traits(
[1422](#1422)        &self,
[1423](#1423)        resolve: &Resolve,
[1424](#1424)        world_trait: Option<&GeneratedTrait>,
[1425](#1425)    ) -> (Vec<String>, Vec<String>) {
[1426](#1426)        let mut sync = Vec::new();
[1427](#1427)        let mut concurrent = Vec::new();
[1428](#1428)        for (id, path) in self.import_interface_paths() {
[1429](#1429)            sync.push(format!("{path}::Host"));
[1430](#1430)            if self.import_interface_any_concurrent(resolve, id) {
[1431](#1431)                concurrent.push(format!("{path}::HostConcurrent"));
[1432](#1432)            }
[1433](#1433)        }
[1434](#1434)        if let Some(world_trait) = world_trait {
[1435](#1435)            sync.push(world_trait.name.clone());
[1436](#1436)            concurrent.extend(world_trait.concurrent_name.clone());
[1437](#1437)        }
[1438](#1438)        if let CallStyle::Async | CallStyle::Concurrent = self.opts.call_style() {
[1439](#1439)            sync.push("Send".to_string());
[1440](#1440)            if !concurrent.is_empty() {
[1441](#1441)                concurrent.push("Send".to_string());
[1442](#1442)            }
[1443](#1443)        }
[1444](#1444)        (sync, concurrent)
[1445](#1445)    }
[1446](#1446)
[1447](#1447)    fn world_add_to_linker(
[1448](#1448)        &mut self,
[1449](#1449)        resolve: &Resolve,
[1450](#1450)        world: WorldId,
[1451](#1451)        world_trait: Option<&GeneratedTrait>,
[1452](#1452)    ) {
[1453](#1453)        let has_world_imports_trait = self.has_world_imports_trait(resolve, world);
[1454](#1454)        if self.import_interfaces.is_empty() && !has_world_imports_trait {
[1455](#1455)            return;
[1456](#1456)        }
[1457](#1457)
[1458](#1458)        let (options_param, options_arg) = if self.world_link_options.has_any() {
[1459](#1459)            ("options: &LinkOptions,", ", options")
[1460](#1460)        } else {
[1461](#1461)            ("", "")
[1462](#1462)        };
[1463](#1463)
[1464](#1464)        let opt_t_send_bound = if self.opts.is_store_data_send() {
[1465](#1465)            "+ Send"
[1466](#1466)        } else {
[1467](#1467)            ""
[1468](#1468)        };
[1469](#1469)
[1470](#1470)        let wt = self.wasmtime_path();
[1471](#1471)        if let Some(world_trait) = world_trait {
[1472](#1472)            let d_bound = match &world_trait.concurrent_name {
[1473](#1473)                Some(name) => name.clone(),
[1474](#1474)                None => format!("{wt}::component::HasData"),
[1475](#1475)            };
[1476](#1476)            uwrite!(
[1477](#1477)                self.src,
[1478](#1478)                "
[1479](#1479)                    pub fn add_to_linker_imports<T, D>(
[1480](#1480)                        linker: &mut {wt}::component::Linker<T>,
[1481](#1481)                        {options_param}

[1483](#1483)                    ) -> {wt}::Result<()>
[1484](#1484)                        where
[1485](#1485)                            D: {d_bound},
[1486](#1486)                            for<'a> D::Data<'a>: {name},
[1487](#1487)                            T: 'static {opt_t_send_bound}
[1488](#1488)                    {{
[1489](#1489)                        let mut linker = linker.root();
[1490](#1490)                ",
[1491](#1491)                name = world_trait.name,
[1492](#1492)            );
[1493](#1493)            let gate = FeatureGate::open(&mut self.src, &resolve.worlds[world].stability);
[1494](#1494)            for (ty, name) in get_world_resources(resolve, world) {
[1495](#1495)                Self::generate_add_resource_to_linker(
[1496](#1496)                    None,
[1497](#1497)                    &mut self.src,
[1498](#1498)                    &self.opts,
[1499](#1499)                    &wt,
[1500](#1500)                    "linker",
[1501](#1501)                    name,
[1502](#1502)                    &resolve.types[ty].stability,
[1503](#1503)                );
[1504](#1504)            }
[1505](#1505)            for f in self.import_functions.clone() {
[1506](#1506)                let mut generator = InterfaceGenerator::new(self, resolve);
[1507](#1507)                generator.generate_add_function_to_linker(TypeOwner::World(world), &f, "linker");
[1508](#1508)                let src = String::from(generator.src);
[1509](#1509)                self.src.push_str(&src);
[1510](#1510)                self.src.push_str("\n");
[1511](#1511)            }
[1512](#1512)            gate.close(&mut self.src);
[1513](#1513)            uwriteln!(self.src, "Ok(())\n}}");
[1514](#1514)        }
[1515](#1515)
[1516](#1516)        let (sync_bounds, concurrent_bounds) = self.world_host_traits(resolve, world_trait);
[1517](#1517)        let sync_bounds = sync_bounds.join(" + ");
[1518](#1518)        let concurrent_bounds = concurrent_bounds.join(" + ");
[1519](#1519)        let d_bounds = if !concurrent_bounds.is_empty() {
[1520](#1520)            concurrent_bounds
[1521](#1521)        } else {
[1522](#1522)            format!("{wt}::component::HasData")
[1523](#1523)        };
[1524](#1524)
[1525](#1525)        uwriteln!(
[1526](#1526)            self.src,
[1527](#1527)            "
[1528](#1528)                pub fn add_to_linker<T, D>(
[1529](#1529)                    linker: &mut {wt}::component::Linker<T>,
[1530](#1530)                    {options_param}
[1531](#1531)                    host_getter: fn(&mut T) -> D::Data<'_>,
[1532](#1532)                ) -> {wt}::Result<()>
[1533](#1533)                    where
[1534](#1534)                        D: {d_bounds},
[1535](#1535)                        for<'a> D::Data<'a>: {sync_bounds},
[1536](#1536)                        T: 'static {opt_t_send_bound}
[1537](#1537)                {{
[1538](#1538)            "
[1539](#1539)        );
[1540](#1540)        let gate = FeatureGate::open(&mut self.src, &resolve.worlds[world].stability);
[1541](#1541)        if has_world_imports_trait {
[1542](#1542)            uwriteln!(
[1543](#1543)                self.src,
[1544](#1544)                "Self::add_to_linker_imports::<T, D>(linker {options_arg}, host_getter)?;"
[1545](#1545)            );
[1546](#1546)        }
[1547](#1547)        for (interface_id, path) in self.import_interface_paths() {
[1548](#1548)            let options_arg = if self.interface_link_options[&interface_id].has_any() {
[1549](#1549)                ", &options.into()"
[1550](#1550)            } else {
[1551](#1551)                ""
[1552](#1552)            };
[1553](#1553)
[1554](#1554)            let import_stability = resolve.worlds[world]
[1555](#1555)                .imports
[1556](#1556)                .iter()
[1557](#1557)                .filter_map(|(_, i)| match i {
[1558](#1558)                    WorldItem::Interface { id, stability } if *id == interface_id => {
[1559](#1559)                        Some(stability.clone())
[1560](#1560)                    }
[1561](#1561)                    _ => None,
[1562](#1562)                })
[1563](#1563)                .next()
[1564](#1564)                .unwrap_or(Stability::Unknown);
[1565](#1565)
[1566](#1566)            let gate = FeatureGate::open(&mut self.src, &import_stability);
[1567](#1567)            uwriteln!(
[1568](#1568)                self.src,
[1569](#1569)                "{path}::add_to_linker::<T, D>(linker {options_arg}, host_getter)?;"
[1570](#1570)            );
[1571](#1571)            gate.close(&mut self.src);
[1572](#1572)        }
[1573](#1573)        gate.close(&mut self.src);
[1574](#1574)        uwriteln!(self.src, "Ok(())\n}}");
[1575](#1575)    }
[1576](#1576)
[1577](#1577)    fn generate_add_resource_to_linker(
[1578](#1578)        qualifier: Option<&str>,
[1579](#1579)        src: &mut Source,
[1580](#1580)        opts: &Opts,
[1581](#1581)        wt: &str,
[1582](#1582)        inst: &str,
[1583](#1583)        name: &str,
[1584](#1584)        stability: &Stability,
[1585](#1585)    ) {
[1586](#1586)        let gate = FeatureGate::open(src, stability);
[1587](#1587)        let camel = name.to_upper_camel_case();
[1588](#1588)        if let CallStyle::Async | CallStyle::Concurrent = opts.drop_call_style(qualifier, name) {
[1589](#1589)            uwriteln!(
[1590](#1590)                src,
[1591](#1591)                "{inst}.resource_async(
[1592](#1592)                    \"{name}\",
[1593](#1593)                    {wt}::component::ResourceType::host::<{camel}>(),
[1594](#1594)                    move |mut store, rep| {{
[1595](#1595)                        {wt}::component::__internal::Box::new(async move {{
[1596](#1596)                            Host{camel}::drop(&mut host_getter(store.data_mut()), {wt}::component::Resource::new_own(rep)).await
[1597](#1597)                        }})
[1598](#1598)                    }},
[1599](#1599)                )?;"
[1600](#1600)            )
[1601](#1601)        } else {
[1602](#1602)            uwriteln!(
[1603](#1603)                src,
[1604](#1604)                "{inst}.resource(
[1605](#1605)                    \"{name}\",
[1606](#1606)                    {wt}::component::ResourceType::host::<{camel}>(),
[1607](#1607)                    move |mut store, rep| -> {wt}::Result<()> {{
[1608](#1608)                        Host{camel}::drop(&mut host_getter(store.data_mut()), {wt}::component::Resource::new_own(rep))
[1609](#1609)                    }},
[1610](#1610)                )?;"
[1611](#1611)            )
[1612](#1612)        }
[1613](#1613)        gate.close(src);
[1614](#1614)    }
[1615](#1615)}
[1616](#1616)
[1617](#1617)struct InterfaceGenerator<'a> {
[1618](#1618)    src: Source,
[1619](#1619)    generator: &'a mut Wasmtime,
[1620](#1620)    resolve: &'a Resolve,
[1621](#1621)    current_interface: Option<(InterfaceId, &'a WorldKey, bool)>,
[1622](#1622)}
[1623](#1623)
[1624](#1624)impl<'a> InterfaceGenerator<'a> {
[1625](#1625)    fn new(generator: &'a mut Wasmtime, resolve: &'a Resolve) -> InterfaceGenerator<'a> {
[1626](#1626)        InterfaceGenerator {
[1627](#1627)            src: Source::default(),
[1628](#1628)            generator,
[1629](#1629)            resolve,
[1630](#1630)            current_interface: None,
[1631](#1631)        }
[1632](#1632)    }
[1633](#1633)
[1634](#1634)    fn types_imported(&self) -> bool {
[1635](#1635)        match self.current_interface {
[1636](#1636)            Some((_, _, is_export)) => !is_export,
[1637](#1637)            None => true,
[1638](#1638)        }
[1639](#1639)    }
[1640](#1640)
[1641](#1641)    fn types(&mut self, id: InterfaceId) {
[1642](#1642)        for (name, id) in self.resolve.interfaces[id].types.iter() {
[1643](#1643)            self.define_type(name, *id);
[1644](#1644)        }
[1645](#1645)    }
[1646](#1646)
[1647](#1647)    fn define_type(&mut self, name: &str, id: TypeId) {
[1648](#1648)        let ty = &self.resolve.types[id];
[1649](#1649)        match &ty.kind {
[1650](#1650)            TypeDefKind::Record(record) => self.type_record(id, name, record, &ty.docs),
[1651](#1651)            TypeDefKind::Flags(flags) => self.type_flags(id, name, flags, &ty.docs),
[1652](#1652)            TypeDefKind::Tuple(tuple) => self.type_tuple(id, name, tuple, &ty.docs),
[1653](#1653)            TypeDefKind::Enum(enum_) => self.type_enum(id, name, enum_, &ty.docs),
[1654](#1654)            TypeDefKind::Variant(variant) => self.type_variant(id, name, variant, &ty.docs),
[1655](#1655)            TypeDefKind::Option(t) => self.type_option(id, name, t, &ty.docs),
[1656](#1656)            TypeDefKind::Result(r) => self.type_result(id, name, r, &ty.docs),
[1657](#1657)            TypeDefKind::List(t) => self.type_list(id, name, t, &ty.docs),
[1658](#1658)            TypeDefKind::Type(t) => self.type_alias(id, name, t, &ty.docs),
[1659](#1659)            TypeDefKind::Future(t) => self.type_future(id, name, t.as_ref(), &ty.docs),
[1660](#1660)            TypeDefKind::Stream(t) => self.type_stream(id, name, t.as_ref(), &ty.docs),
[1661](#1661)            TypeDefKind::Handle(handle) => self.type_handle(id, name, handle, &ty.docs),
[1662](#1662)            TypeDefKind::Resource => self.type_resource(id, name, ty, &ty.docs),
[1663](#1663)            TypeDefKind::Unknown => unreachable!(),
[1664](#1664)            TypeDefKind::FixedSizeList(..) => todo!(),
[1665](#1665)        }
[1666](#1666)    }
[1667](#1667)
[1668](#1668)    fn type_handle(&mut self, id: TypeId, name: &str, handle: &Handle, docs: &Docs) {
[1669](#1669)        self.rustdoc(docs);
[1670](#1670)        let name = name.to_upper_camel_case();
[1671](#1671)        uwriteln!(self.src, "pub type {name} = ");
[1672](#1672)        self.print_handle(handle);
[1673](#1673)        self.push_str(";\n");
[1674](#1674)        self.assert_type(id, &name);
[1675](#1675)    }
[1676](#1676)
[1677](#1677)    fn type_resource(&mut self, id: TypeId, name: &str, _resource: &TypeDef, docs: &Docs) {
[1678](#1678)        let camel = name.to_upper_camel_case();
[1679](#1679)        let wt = self.generator.wasmtime_path();
[1680](#1680)
[1681](#1681)        if self.types_imported() {
[1682](#1682)            self.rustdoc(docs);
[1683](#1683)
[1684](#1684)            let replacement = match self.current_interface {
[1685](#1685)                Some((_, key, _)) => {
[1686](#1686)                    self.generator
[1687](#1687)                        .lookup_replacement(self.resolve, key, Some(name))
[1688](#1688)                }
[1689](#1689)                None => {
[1690](#1690)                    self.generator.used_with_opts.insert(name.into());
[1691](#1691)                    self.generator.opts.with.get(name).cloned()
[1692](#1692)                }
[1693](#1693)            };
[1694](#1694)            match replacement {
[1695](#1695)                Some(path) => {
[1696](#1696)                    uwriteln!(
[1697](#1697)                        self.src,
[1698](#1698)                        "pub use {}{path} as {camel};",
[1699](#1699)                        self.path_to_root()
[1700](#1700)                    );
[1701](#1701)                }
[1702](#1702)                None => {
[1703](#1703)                    uwriteln!(self.src, "pub enum {camel} {{}}");
[1704](#1704)                }
[1705](#1705)            }
[1706](#1706)
[1707](#1707)            let functions = get_resource_functions(self.resolve, id);
[1710](#1710)            self.generate_trait(
[1711](#1711)                &format!("Host{camel}"),
[1712](#1712)                &functions,
[1713](#1713)                &[ExtraTraitMethod::ResourceDrop { name }],
[1714](#1714)                &[],
[1715](#1715)            );
[1716](#1716)        } else {
[1717](#1717)            self.rustdoc(docs);
[1718](#1718)            uwriteln!(
[1719](#1719)                self.src,
[1720](#1720)                "
[1721](#1721)                    pub type {camel} = {wt}::component::ResourceAny;
[1722](#1722)
[1723](#1723)                    pub struct Guest{camel}<'a> {{
[1724](#1724)                        funcs: &'a Guest,
[1725](#1725)                    }}
[1726](#1726)                "
[1727](#1727)            );
[1728](#1728)        }
[1729](#1729)    }
[1730](#1730)
[1731](#1731)    fn type_record(&mut self, id: TypeId, _name: &str, record: &Record, docs: &Docs) {
[1732](#1732)        let info = self.info(id);
[1733](#1733)        let wt = self.generator.wasmtime_path();
[1734](#1734)
[1735](#1735)        let additional_derives: BTreeSet<String> = self
[1737](#1737)            .generator
[1738](#1738)            .opts
[1739](#1739)            .additional_derive_attributes
[1740](#1740)            .iter()
[1741](#1741)            .cloned()
[1742](#1742)            .collect();
[1743](#1743)
[1744](#1744)        for (name, mode) in self.modes_of(id) {
[1745](#1745)            let lt = self.lifetime_for(&info, mode);
[1746](#1746)            self.rustdoc(docs);
[1747](#1747)
[1748](#1748)            let mut derives = additional_derives.clone();
[1749](#1749)
[1750](#1750)            uwriteln!(self.src, "#[derive({wt}::component::ComponentType)]");
[1751](#1751)            if lt.is_none() {
[1752](#1752)                uwriteln!(self.src, "#[derive({wt}::component::Lift)]");
[1753](#1753)            }
[1754](#1754)            uwriteln!(self.src, "#[derive({wt}::component::Lower)]");
[1755](#1755)            self.push_str("#[component(record)]\n");
[1756](#1756)            if let Some(path) = &self.generator.opts.wasmtime_crate {
[1757](#1757)                uwriteln!(self.src, "#[component(wasmtime_crate = {path})]\n");
[1758](#1758)            }
[1759](#1759)
[1760](#1760)            if info.is_copy() {
[1761](#1761)                derives.extend(["Copy", "Clone"].into_iter().map(|s| s.to_string()));
[1762](#1762)            } else if info.is_clone() {
[1763](#1763)                derives.insert("Clone".to_string());
[1764](#1764)            }
[1765](#1765)
[1766](#1766)            if !derives.is_empty() {
[1767](#1767)                self.push_str("#[derive(");
[1768](#1768)                self.push_str(&derives.into_iter().collect::<Vec<_>>().join(", "));
[1769](#1769)                self.push_str(")]\n")
[1770](#1770)            }
[1771](#1771)
[1772](#1772)            self.push_str(&format!("pub struct {name}"));
[1773](#1773)            self.print_generics(lt);
[1774](#1774)            self.push_str(" {\n");
[1775](#1775)            for field in record.fields.iter() {
[1776](#1776)                self.rustdoc(&field.docs);
[1777](#1777)                self.push_str(&format!("#[component(name = \"{}\")]\n", field.name));
[1778](#1778)                self.push_str("pub ");
[1779](#1779)                self.push_str(&to_rust_ident(&field.name));
[1780](#1780)                self.push_str(": ");
[1781](#1781)                self.print_ty(&field.ty, mode);
[1782](#1782)                self.push_str(",\n");
[1783](#1783)            }
[1784](#1784)            self.push_str("}\n");
[1785](#1785)
[1786](#1786)            self.push_str("impl");
[1787](#1787)            self.print_generics(lt);
[1788](#1788)            self.push_str(" core::fmt::Debug for ");
[1789](#1789)            self.push_str(&name);
[1790](#1790)            self.print_generics(lt);
[1791](#1791)            self.push_str(" {\n");
[1792](#1792)            self.push_str(
[1793](#1793)                "fn fmt(&self, f: &mut core::fmt::Formatter<'_>) -> core::fmt::Result {\n",
[1794](#1794)            );
[1795](#1795)            self.push_str(&format!("f.debug_struct(\"{name}\")"));
[1796](#1796)            for field in record.fields.iter() {
[1797](#1797)                self.push_str(&format!(
[1798](#1798)                    ".field(\"{}\", &self.{})",
[1799](#1799)                    field.name,
[1800](#1800)                    to_rust_ident(&field.name)
[1801](#1801)                ));
[1802](#1802)            }
[1803](#1803)            self.push_str(".finish()\n");
[1804](#1804)            self.push_str("}\n");
[1805](#1805)            self.push_str("}\n");
[1806](#1806)
[1807](#1807)            if info.error {
[1808](#1808)                self.push_str("impl");
[1809](#1809)                self.print_generics(lt);
[1810](#1810)                self.push_str(" core::fmt::Display for ");
[1811](#1811)                self.push_str(&name);
[1812](#1812)                self.print_generics(lt);
[1813](#1813)                self.push_str(" {\n");
[1814](#1814)                self.push_str(
[1815](#1815)                    "fn fmt(&self, f: &mut core::fmt::Formatter<'_>) -> core::fmt::Result {\n",
[1816](#1816)                );
[1817](#1817)                self.push_str("write!(f, \"{:?}\", self)\n");
[1818](#1818)                self.push_str("}\n");
[1819](#1819)                self.push_str("}\n");
[1820](#1820)
[1821](#1821)                self.push_str("impl core::error::Error for ");
[1822](#1822)                self.push_str(&name);
[1823](#1823)                self.push_str("{}\n");
[1824](#1824)            }
[1825](#1825)            self.assert_type(id, &name);
[1826](#1826)        }
[1827](#1827)    }
[1828](#1828)
[1829](#1829)    fn type_tuple(&mut self, id: TypeId, _name: &str, tuple: &Tuple, docs: &Docs) {
[1830](#1830)        let info = self.info(id);
[1831](#1831)        for (name, mode) in self.modes_of(id) {
[1832](#1832)            let lt = self.lifetime_for(&info, mode);
[1833](#1833)            self.rustdoc(docs);
[1834](#1834)            self.push_str(&format!("pub type {name}"));
[1835](#1835)            self.print_generics(lt);
[1836](#1836)            self.push_str(" = (");
[1837](#1837)            for ty in tuple.types.iter() {
[1838](#1838)                self.print_ty(ty, mode);
[1839](#1839)                self.push_str(",");
[1840](#1840)            }
[1841](#1841)            self.push_str(");\n");
[1842](#1842)            self.assert_type(id, &name);
[1843](#1843)        }
[1844](#1844)    }
[1845](#1845)
[1846](#1846)    fn type_flags(&mut self, id: TypeId, name: &str, flags: &Flags, docs: &Docs) {
[1847](#1847)        self.rustdoc(docs);
[1848](#1848)        let wt = self.generator.wasmtime_path();
[1849](#1849)        let rust_name = to_rust_upper_camel_case(name);
[1850](#1850)        uwriteln!(self.src, "{wt}::component::flags!(\n");
[1851](#1851)        self.src.push_str(&format!("{rust_name} {{\n"));
[1852](#1852)        for flag in flags.flags.iter() {
[1853](#1853)            uwrite!(
[1855](#1855)                self.src,
[1856](#1856)                "#[component(name=\"{}\")] const {};\n",
[1857](#1857)                flag.name,
[1858](#1858)                flag.name.to_shouty_snake_case()
[1859](#1859)            );
[1860](#1860)        }
[1861](#1861)        self.src.push_str("}\n");
[1862](#1862)        self.src.push_str(");\n\n");
[1863](#1863)        self.assert_type(id, &rust_name);
[1864](#1864)    }
[1865](#1865)
[1866](#1866)    fn type_variant(&mut self, id: TypeId, _name: &str, variant: &Variant, docs: &Docs) {
[1867](#1867)        self.print_rust_enum(
[1868](#1868)            id,
[1869](#1869)            variant.cases.iter().map(|c| {
[1870](#1870)                (
[1871](#1871)                    c.name.to_upper_camel_case(),
[1872](#1872)                    Some(c.name.clone()),
[1873](#1873)                    &c.docs,
[1874](#1874)                    c.ty.as_ref(),
[1875](#1875)                )
[1876](#1876)            }),
[1877](#1877)            docs,
[1878](#1878)            "variant",
[1879](#1879)        );
[1880](#1880)    }
[1881](#1881)
[1882](#1882)    fn type_option(&mut self, id: TypeId, _name: &str, payload: &Type, docs: &Docs) {
[1883](#1883)        let info = self.info(id);
[1884](#1884)
[1885](#1885)        for (name, mode) in self.modes_of(id) {
[1886](#1886)            self.rustdoc(docs);
[1887](#1887)            let lt = self.lifetime_for(&info, mode);
[1888](#1888)            self.push_str(&format!("pub type {name}"));
[1889](#1889)            self.print_generics(lt);
[1890](#1890)            self.push_str("= Option<");
[1891](#1891)            self.print_ty(payload, mode);
[1892](#1892)            self.push_str(">;\n");
[1893](#1893)            self.assert_type(id, &name);
[1894](#1894)        }
[1895](#1895)    }
[1896](#1896)
[1897](#1897)    fn assert_type(&mut self, id: TypeId, name: &str) {
[1900](#1900)        self.push_str("const _: () = {\n");
[1901](#1901)        let wt = self.generator.wasmtime_path();
[1902](#1902)        uwriteln!(
[1903](#1903)            self.src,
[1904](#1904)            "assert!({} == <{name} as {wt}::component::ComponentType>::SIZE32);",
[1905](#1905)            self.generator.sizes.size(&Type::Id(id)).size_wasm32(),
[1906](#1906)        );
[1907](#1907)        uwriteln!(
[1908](#1908)            self.src,
[1909](#1909)            "assert!({} == <{name} as {wt}::component::ComponentType>::ALIGN32);",
[1910](#1910)            self.generator.sizes.align(&Type::Id(id)).align_wasm32(),
[1911](#1911)        );
[1912](#1912)        self.push_str("};\n");
[1913](#1913)    }
[1914](#1914)
[1915](#1915)    fn print_rust_enum<'b>(
[1916](#1916)        &mut self,
[1917](#1917)        id: TypeId,
[1918](#1918)        cases: impl IntoIterator<Item = (String, Option<String>, &'b Docs, Option<&'b Type>)> + Clone,
[1919](#1919)        docs: &Docs,
[1920](#1920)        derive_component: &str,
[1921](#1921)    ) where
[1922](#1922)        Self: Sized,
[1923](#1923)    {
[1924](#1924)        let info = self.info(id);
[1925](#1925)        let wt = self.generator.wasmtime_path();
[1926](#1926)
[1927](#1927)        let additional_derives: BTreeSet<String> = self
[1929](#1929)            .generator
[1930](#1930)            .opts
[1931](#1931)            .additional_derive_attributes
[1932](#1932)            .iter()
[1933](#1933)            .cloned()
[1934](#1934)            .collect();
[1935](#1935)
[1936](#1936)        for (name, mode) in self.modes_of(id) {
[1937](#1937)            let name = to_rust_upper_camel_case(&name);
[1938](#1938)
[1939](#1939)            let mut derives = additional_derives.clone();
[1940](#1940)
[1941](#1941)            self.rustdoc(docs);
[1942](#1942)            let lt = self.lifetime_for(&info, mode);
[1943](#1943)            uwriteln!(self.src, "#[derive({wt}::component::ComponentType)]");
[1944](#1944)            if lt.is_none() {
[1945](#1945)                uwriteln!(self.src, "#[derive({wt}::component::Lift)]");
[1946](#1946)            }
[1947](#1947)            uwriteln!(self.src, "#[derive({wt}::component::Lower)]");
[1948](#1948)            self.push_str(&format!("#[component({derive_component})]\n"));
[1949](#1949)            if let Some(path) = &self.generator.opts.wasmtime_crate {
[1950](#1950)                uwriteln!(self.src, "#[component(wasmtime_crate = {path})]\n");
[1951](#1951)            }
[1952](#1952)            if info.is_copy() {
[1953](#1953)                derives.extend(["Copy", "Clone"].into_iter().map(|s| s.to_string()));
[1954](#1954)            } else if info.is_clone() {
[1955](#1955)                derives.insert("Clone".to_string());
[1956](#1956)            }
[1957](#1957)
[1958](#1958)            if !derives.is_empty() {
[1959](#1959)                self.push_str("#[derive(");
[1960](#1960)                self.push_str(&derives.into_iter().collect::<Vec<_>>().join(", "));
[1961](#1961)                self.push_str(")]\n")
[1962](#1962)            }
[1963](#1963)
[1964](#1964)            self.push_str(&format!("pub enum {name}"));
[1965](#1965)            self.print_generics(lt);
[1966](#1966)            self.push_str("{\n");
[1967](#1967)            for (case_name, component_name, docs, payload) in cases.clone() {
[1968](#1968)                self.rustdoc(docs);
[1969](#1969)                if let Some(n) = component_name {
[1970](#1970)                    self.push_str(&format!("#[component(name = \"{n}\")] "));
[1971](#1971)                }
[1972](#1972)                self.push_str(&case_name);
[1973](#1973)                if let Some(ty) = payload {
[1974](#1974)                    self.push_str("(");
[1975](#1975)                    self.print_ty(ty, mode);
[1976](#1976)                    self.push_str(")")
[1977](#1977)                }
[1978](#1978)                self.push_str(",\n");
[1979](#1979)            }
[1980](#1980)            self.push_str("}\n");
[1981](#1981)
[1982](#1982)            self.print_rust_enum_debug(
[1983](#1983)                id,
[1984](#1984)                mode,
[1985](#1985)                &name,
[1986](#1986)                cases
[1987](#1987)                    .clone()
[1988](#1988)                    .into_iter()
[1989](#1989)                    .map(|(name, _attr, _docs, ty)| (name, ty)),
[1990](#1990)            );
[1991](#1991)
[1992](#1992)            if info.error {
[1993](#1993)                self.push_str("impl");
[1994](#1994)                self.print_generics(lt);
[1995](#1995)                self.push_str(" core::fmt::Display for ");
[1996](#1996)                self.push_str(&name);
[1997](#1997)                self.print_generics(lt);
[1998](#1998)                self.push_str(" {\n");
[1999](#1999)                self.push_str(
[2000](#2000)                    "fn fmt(&self, f: &mut core::fmt::Formatter<'_>) -> core::fmt::Result {\n",
[2001](#2001)                );
[2002](#2002)                self.push_str("write!(f, \"{:?}\", self)\n");
[2003](#2003)                self.push_str("}\n");
[2004](#2004)                self.push_str("}\n");
[2005](#2005)
[2006](#2006)                self.push_str("impl");
[2007](#2007)                self.print_generics(lt);
[2008](#2008)                self.push_str(" core::error::Error for ");
[2009](#2009)                self.push_str(&name);
[2010](#2010)                self.print_generics(lt);
[2011](#2011)                self.push_str(" {}\n");
[2012](#2012)            }
[2013](#2013)
[2014](#2014)            self.assert_type(id, &name);
[2015](#2015)        }
[2016](#2016)    }
[2017](#2017)
[2018](#2018)    fn print_rust_enum_debug<'b>(
[2019](#2019)        &mut self,
[2020](#2020)        id: TypeId,
[2021](#2021)        mode: TypeMode,
[2022](#2022)        name: &str,
[2023](#2023)        cases: impl IntoIterator<Item = (String, Option<&'b Type>)>,
[2024](#2024)    ) where
[2025](#2025)        Self: Sized,
[2026](#2026)    {
[2027](#2027)        let info = self.info(id);
[2028](#2028)        let lt = self.lifetime_for(&info, mode);
[2029](#2029)        self.push_str("impl");
[2030](#2030)        self.print_generics(lt);
[2031](#2031)        self.push_str(" core::fmt::Debug for ");
[2032](#2032)        self.push_str(name);
[2033](#2033)        self.print_generics(lt);
[2034](#2034)        self.push_str(" {\n");
[2035](#2035)        self.push_str("fn fmt(&self, f: &mut core::fmt::Formatter<'_>) -> core::fmt::Result {\n");
[2036](#2036)        self.push_str("match self {\n");
[2037](#2037)        for (case_name, payload) in cases {
[2038](#2038)            self.push_str(name);
[2039](#2039)            self.push_str("::");
[2040](#2040)            self.push_str(&case_name);
[2041](#2041)            if payload.is_some() {
[2042](#2042)                self.push_str("(e)");
[2043](#2043)            }
[2044](#2044)            self.push_str(" => {\n");
[2045](#2045)            self.push_str(&format!("f.debug_tuple(\"{name}::{case_name}\")"));
[2046](#2046)            if payload.is_some() {
[2047](#2047)                self.push_str(".field(e)");
[2048](#2048)            }
[2049](#2049)            self.push_str(".finish()\n");
[2050](#2050)            self.push_str("}\n");
[2051](#2051)        }
[2052](#2052)        self.push_str("}\n");
[2053](#2053)        self.push_str("}\n");
[2054](#2054)        self.push_str("}\n");
[2055](#2055)    }
[2056](#2056)
[2057](#2057)    fn type_result(&mut self, id: TypeId, _name: &str, result: &Result_, docs: &Docs) {
[2058](#2058)        let info = self.info(id);
[2059](#2059)
[2060](#2060)        for (name, mode) in self.modes_of(id) {
[2061](#2061)            self.rustdoc(docs);
[2062](#2062)            let lt = self.lifetime_for(&info, mode);
[2063](#2063)            self.push_str(&format!("pub type {name}"));
[2064](#2064)            self.print_generics(lt);
[2065](#2065)            self.push_str("= Result<");
[2066](#2066)            self.print_optional_ty(result.ok.as_ref(), mode);
[2067](#2067)            self.push_str(",");
[2068](#2068)            self.print_optional_ty(result.err.as_ref(), mode);
[2069](#2069)            self.push_str(">;\n");
[2070](#2070)            self.assert_type(id, &name);
[2071](#2071)        }
[2072](#2072)    }
[2073](#2073)
[2074](#2074)    fn type_enum(&mut self, id: TypeId, name: &str, enum_: &Enum, docs: &Docs) {
[2075](#2075)        let info = self.info(id);
[2076](#2076)        let wt = self.generator.wasmtime_path();
[2077](#2077)
[2078](#2078)        let mut derives: BTreeSet<String> = self
[2080](#2080)            .generator
[2081](#2081)            .opts
[2082](#2082)            .additional_derive_attributes
[2083](#2083)            .iter()
[2084](#2084)            .cloned()
[2085](#2085)            .collect();
[2086](#2086)
[2087](#2087)        derives.extend(
[2088](#2088)            ["Clone", "Copy", "PartialEq", "Eq"]
[2089](#2089)                .into_iter()
[2090](#2090)                .map(|s| s.to_string()),
[2091](#2091)        );
[2092](#2092)
[2093](#2093)        let name = to_rust_upper_camel_case(name);
[2094](#2094)        self.rustdoc(docs);
[2095](#2095)        uwriteln!(self.src, "#[derive({wt}::component::ComponentType)]");
[2096](#2096)        uwriteln!(self.src, "#[derive({wt}::component::Lift)]");
[2097](#2097)        uwriteln!(self.src, "#[derive({wt}::component::Lower)]");
[2098](#2098)        self.push_str("#[component(enum)]\n");
[2099](#2099)        if let Some(path) = &self.generator.opts.wasmtime_crate {
[2100](#2100)            uwriteln!(self.src, "#[component(wasmtime_crate = {path})]\n");
[2101](#2101)        }
[2102](#2102)
[2103](#2103)        self.push_str("#[derive(");
[2104](#2104)        self.push_str(&derives.into_iter().collect::<Vec<_>>().join(", "));
[2105](#2105)        self.push_str(")]\n");
[2106](#2106)
[2107](#2107)        let repr = match enum_.cases.len().ilog2() {
[2108](#2108)            0..=7 => "u8",
[2109](#2109)            8..=15 => "u16",
[2110](#2110)            _ => "u32",
[2111](#2111)        };
[2112](#2112)        uwriteln!(self.src, "#[repr({repr})]");
[2113](#2113)
[2114](#2114)        self.push_str(&format!("pub enum {name} {{\n"));
[2115](#2115)        for case in enum_.cases.iter() {
[2116](#2116)            self.rustdoc(&case.docs);
[2117](#2117)            self.push_str(&format!("#[component(name = \"{}\")]", case.name));
[2118](#2118)            self.push_str(&case.name.to_upper_camel_case());
[2119](#2119)            self.push_str(",\n");
[2120](#2120)        }
[2121](#2121)        self.push_str("}\n");
[2122](#2122)
[2123](#2123)        if info.error {
[2126](#2126)            self.push_str("impl ");
[2127](#2127)            self.push_str(&name);
[2128](#2128)            self.push_str("{\n");
[2129](#2129)
[2130](#2130)            self.push_str("pub fn name(&self) -> &'static str {\n");
[2131](#2131)            self.push_str("match self {\n");
[2132](#2132)            for case in enum_.cases.iter() {
[2133](#2133)                self.push_str(&name);
[2134](#2134)                self.push_str("::");
[2135](#2135)                self.push_str(&case.name.to_upper_camel_case());
[2136](#2136)                self.push_str(" => \"");
[2137](#2137)                self.push_str(case.name.as_str());
[2138](#2138)                self.push_str("\",\n");
[2139](#2139)            }
[2140](#2140)            self.push_str("}\n");
[2141](#2141)            self.push_str("}\n");
[2142](#2142)
[2143](#2143)            self.push_str("pub fn message(&self) -> &'static str {\n");
[2144](#2144)            self.push_str("match self {\n");
[2145](#2145)            for case in enum_.cases.iter() {
[2146](#2146)                self.push_str(&name);
[2147](#2147)                self.push_str("::");
[2148](#2148)                self.push_str(&case.name.to_upper_camel_case());
[2149](#2149)                self.push_str(" => \"");
[2150](#2150)                if let Some(contents) = &case.docs.contents {
[2151](#2151)                    self.push_str(contents.trim());
[2152](#2152)                }
[2153](#2153)                self.push_str("\",\n");
[2154](#2154)            }
[2155](#2155)            self.push_str("}\n");
[2156](#2156)            self.push_str("}\n");
[2157](#2157)
[2158](#2158)            self.push_str("}\n");
[2159](#2159)
[2160](#2160)            self.push_str("impl core::fmt::Debug for ");
[2161](#2161)            self.push_str(&name);
[2162](#2162)            self.push_str(
[2163](#2163)                "{\nfn fmt(&self, f: &mut core::fmt::Formatter<'_>) -> core::fmt::Result {\n",
[2164](#2164)            );
[2165](#2165)            self.push_str("f.debug_struct(\"");
[2166](#2166)            self.push_str(&name);
[2167](#2167)            self.push_str("\")\n");
[2168](#2168)            self.push_str(".field(\"code\", &(*self as i32))\n");
[2169](#2169)            self.push_str(".field(\"name\", &self.name())\n");
[2170](#2170)            self.push_str(".field(\"message\", &self.message())\n");
[2171](#2171)            self.push_str(".finish()\n");
[2172](#2172)            self.push_str("}\n");
[2173](#2173)            self.push_str("}\n");
[2174](#2174)
[2175](#2175)            self.push_str("impl core::fmt::Display for ");
[2176](#2176)            self.push_str(&name);
[2177](#2177)            self.push_str(
[2178](#2178)                "{\nfn fmt(&self, f: &mut core::fmt::Formatter<'_>) -> core::fmt::Result {\n",
[2179](#2179)            );
[2180](#2180)            self.push_str("write!(f, \"{} (error {})\", self.name(), *self as i32)");
[2181](#2181)            self.push_str("}\n");
[2182](#2182)            self.push_str("}\n");
[2183](#2183)            self.push_str("\n");
[2184](#2184)            self.push_str("impl core::error::Error for ");
[2185](#2185)            self.push_str(&name);
[2186](#2186)            self.push_str("{}\n");
[2187](#2187)        } else {
[2188](#2188)            self.print_rust_enum_debug(
[2189](#2189)                id,
[2190](#2190)                TypeMode::Owned,
[2191](#2191)                &name,
[2192](#2192)                enum_
[2193](#2193)                    .cases
[2194](#2194)                    .iter()
[2195](#2195)                    .map(|c| (c.name.to_upper_camel_case(), None)),
[2196](#2196)            )
[2197](#2197)        }
[2198](#2198)        self.assert_type(id, &name);
[2199](#2199)    }
[2200](#2200)
[2201](#2201)    fn type_alias(&mut self, id: TypeId, _name: &str, ty: &Type, docs: &Docs) {
[2202](#2202)        let info = self.info(id);
[2203](#2203)        for (name, mode) in self.modes_of(id) {
[2204](#2204)            self.rustdoc(docs);
[2205](#2205)            self.push_str(&format!("pub type {name}"));
[2206](#2206)            let lt = self.lifetime_for(&info, mode);
[2207](#2207)            self.print_generics(lt);
[2208](#2208)            self.push_str(" = ");
[2209](#2209)            self.print_ty(ty, mode);
[2210](#2210)            self.push_str(";\n");
[2211](#2211)            let def_id = resolve_type_definition_id(self.resolve, id);
[2212](#2212)            if !matches!(self.resolve().types[def_id].kind, TypeDefKind::Resource) {
[2213](#2213)                self.assert_type(id, &name);
[2214](#2214)            }
[2215](#2215)        }
[2216](#2216)    }

[2258](#2258)
[2259](#2259)    fn special_case_trappable_error(
[2260](#2260)        &mut self,
[2261](#2261)        func: &Function,
[2262](#2262)    ) -> Option<(&'a Result_, TypeId, String)> {
[2263](#2263)        self.generator
[2264](#2264)            .used_trappable_imports_opts
[2265](#2265)            .insert(func.name.clone());
[2266](#2266)
[2267](#2267)        let result = func.result?;
[2268](#2268)
[2269](#2269)        let id = match result {
[2273](#2273)            Type::Id(id) => id,
[2274](#2274)            _ => return None,
[2275](#2275)        };
[2276](#2276)        let result = match &self.resolve.types[id].kind {
[2277](#2277)            TypeDefKind::Result(r) => r,
[2278](#2278)            _ => return None,
[2279](#2279)        };
[2280](#2280)        let error_typeid = match result.err? {
[2281](#2281)            Type::Id(id) => resolve_type_definition_id(&self.resolve, id),
[2282](#2282)            _ => return None,
[2283](#2283)        };
[2284](#2284)
[2285](#2285)        let name = self.generator.trappable_errors.get(&error_typeid)?;
[2286](#2286)
[2287](#2287)        let mut path = self.path_to_root();
[2288](#2288)        uwrite!(path, "{name}");
[2289](#2289)        Some((result, error_typeid, path))
[2290](#2290)    }
[2291](#2291)
[2292](#2292)    fn generate_add_to_linker(&mut self, id: InterfaceId, name: &str) {
[2293](#2293)        let iface = &self.resolve.interfaces[id];
[2294](#2294)        let owner = TypeOwner::Interface(id);
[2295](#2295)        let wt = self.generator.wasmtime_path();
[2296](#2296)
[2297](#2297)        let mut required_conversion_traits = IndexSet::new();
[2298](#2298)        let extra_functions = {
[2299](#2299)            let mut functions = Vec::new();
[2300](#2300)            let mut errors_converted = IndexMap::new();
[2301](#2301)            let mut my_error_types = iface
[2302](#2302)                .types
[2303](#2303)                .iter()
[2304](#2304)                .filter(|(_, id)| self.generator.trappable_errors.contains_key(*id))
[2305](#2305)                .map(|(_, id)| *id)
[2306](#2306)                .collect::<Vec<_>>();
[2307](#2307)            my_error_types.extend(
[2308](#2308)                iface
[2309](#2309)                    .functions
[2310](#2310)                    .iter()
[2311](#2311)                    .filter_map(|(_, func)| self.special_case_trappable_error(func))
[2312](#2312)                    .map(|(_, id, _)| id),
[2313](#2313)            );
[2314](#2314)            for err_id in my_error_types {
[2315](#2315)                let err = &self.resolve.types[resolve_type_definition_id(self.resolve, err_id)];
[2316](#2316)                let err_name = err.name.as_ref().unwrap();
[2317](#2317)                let owner = match err.owner {
[2318](#2318)                    TypeOwner::Interface(i) => i,
[2319](#2319)                    _ => unimplemented!(),
[2320](#2320)                };
[2321](#2321)                match self.path_to_interface(owner) {
[2322](#2322)                    Some(path) => {
[2323](#2323)                        required_conversion_traits.insert(format!("{path}::Host"));
[2324](#2324)                    }
[2325](#2325)                    None => {
[2326](#2326)                        if errors_converted.insert(err_name, err_id).is_none() {
[2327](#2327)                            functions.push(ExtraTraitMethod::ErrorConvert {
[2328](#2328)                                name: err_name,
[2329](#2329)                                id: err_id,
[2330](#2330)                            })
[2331](#2331)                        }
[2332](#2332)                    }
[2333](#2333)                }
[2334](#2334)            }
[2335](#2335)            functions
[2336](#2336)        };
[2337](#2337)
[2338](#2338)        let generated_trait = self.generate_trait(
[2342](#2342)            "Host",
[2343](#2343)            &iface
[2344](#2344)                .functions
[2345](#2345)                .iter()
[2346](#2346)                .filter_map(|(_, f)| {
[2347](#2347)                    if f.kind.resource().is_none() {
[2348](#2348)                        Some(f)
[2349](#2349)                    } else {
[2350](#2350)                        None
[2351](#2351)                    }
[2352](#2352)                })
[2353](#2353)                .collect::<Vec<_>>(),
[2354](#2354)            &extra_functions,
[2355](#2355)            &get_resources(self.resolve, id).collect::<Vec<_>>(),
[2356](#2356)        );
[2357](#2357)
[2358](#2358)        let opt_t_send_bound = match self.generator.opts.call_style() {
[2359](#2359)            CallStyle::Async | CallStyle::Concurrent => "+ Send",
[2360](#2360)            CallStyle::Sync => "",
[2361](#2361)        };
[2362](#2362)
[2363](#2363)        let mut sync_bounds = "Host".to_string();
[2364](#2364)
[2365](#2365)        for ty in required_conversion_traits {
[2366](#2366)            uwrite!(sync_bounds, " + {ty}");
[2367](#2367)        }
[2368](#2368)
[2369](#2369)        let options_param = if self.generator.interface_link_options[&id].has_any() {
[2370](#2370)            "options: &LinkOptions,"
[2371](#2371)        } else {
[2372](#2372)            ""
[2373](#2373)        };
[2374](#2374)
[2375](#2375)        let d_bound = if generated_trait.any_concurrent {
[2376](#2376)            "HostConcurrent".to_string()
[2377](#2377)        } else {
[2378](#2378)            format!("{wt}::component::HasData")
[2379](#2379)        };
[2380](#2380)        uwriteln!(
[2381](#2381)            self.src,
[2382](#2382)            "
[2383](#2383)                pub fn add_to_linker<T, D>(
[2384](#2384)                    linker: &mut {wt}::component::Linker<T>,
[2385](#2385)                    {options_param}
[2386](#2386)                    host_getter: fn(&mut T) -> D::Data<'_>,
[2387](#2387)                ) -> {wt}::Result<()>
[2388](#2388)                    where
[2389](#2389)                        D: {d_bound},
[2390](#2390)                        for<'a> D::Data<'a>: {sync_bounds},
[2391](#2391)                        T: 'static {opt_t_send_bound},
[2392](#2392)                {{
[2393](#2393)            "
[2394](#2394)        );
[2395](#2395)
[2396](#2396)        let gate = FeatureGate::open(&mut self.src, &iface.stability);
[2397](#2397)        uwriteln!(self.src, "let mut inst = linker.instance(\"{name}\")?;");
[2398](#2398)
[2399](#2399)        for (ty, name) in get_resources(self.resolve, id) {
[2400](#2400)            Wasmtime::generate_add_resource_to_linker(
[2401](#2401)                self.qualifier().as_deref(),
[2402](#2402)                &mut self.src,
[2403](#2403)                &self.generator.opts,
[2404](#2404)                &wt,
[2405](#2405)                "inst",
[2406](#2406)                name,
[2407](#2407)                &self.resolve.types[ty].stability,
[2408](#2408)            );
[2409](#2409)        }
[2410](#2410)
[2411](#2411)        for (_, func) in iface.functions.iter() {
[2412](#2412)            self.generate_add_function_to_linker(owner, func, "inst");
[2413](#2413)        }
[2414](#2414)        gate.close(&mut self.src);
[2415](#2415)        uwriteln!(self.src, "Ok(())");
[2416](#2416)        uwriteln!(self.src, "}}");
[2417](#2417)    }
[2418](#2418)
[2419](#2419)    fn qualifier(&self) -> Option<String> {
[2420](#2420)        self.current_interface
[2421](#2421)            .map(|(_, key, _)| self.resolve.name_world_key(key))
[2422](#2422)    }
[2423](#2423)
[2424](#2424)    fn generate_add_function_to_linker(&mut self, owner: TypeOwner, func: &Function, linker: &str) {
[2425](#2425)        let gate = FeatureGate::open(&mut self.src, &func.stability);
[2426](#2426)        uwrite!(
[2427](#2427)            self.src,
[2428](#2428)            "{linker}.{}(\"{}\", ",
[2429](#2429)            match self.import_call_style(func) {
[2430](#2430)                CallStyle::Sync => "func_wrap",
[2431](#2431)                CallStyle::Async => "func_wrap_async",
[2432](#2432)                CallStyle::Concurrent => "func_wrap_concurrent",
[2433](#2433)            },
[2434](#2434)            func.name
[2435](#2435)        );
[2436](#2436)        self.generate_guest_import_closure(owner, func);
[2437](#2437)        uwriteln!(self.src, ")?;");
[2438](#2438)        gate.close(&mut self.src);
[2439](#2439)    }
[2440](#2440)
[2441](#2441)    fn generate_guest_import_closure(&mut self, owner: TypeOwner, func: &Function) {
[2442](#2442)        let style = self.import_call_style(func);
[2446](#2446)
[2447](#2447)        let wt = self.generator.wasmtime_path();
[2448](#2448)        if let CallStyle::Concurrent = style {
[2449](#2449)            uwrite!(
[2450](#2450)                self.src,
[2451](#2451)                "move |caller: &mut {wt}::component::Accessor::<T>, ("
[2452](#2452)            );
[2453](#2453)        } else {
[2454](#2454)            uwrite!(
[2455](#2455)                self.src,
[2456](#2456)                "move |mut caller: {wt}::StoreContextMut<'_, T>, ("
[2457](#2457)            );
[2458](#2458)        }
[2459](#2459)        for (i, _param) in func.params.iter().enumerate() {
[2460](#2460)            uwrite!(self.src, "arg{},", i);
[2461](#2461)        }
[2462](#2462)        self.src.push_str(") : (");
[2463](#2463)
[2464](#2464)        for (_, ty) in func.params.iter() {
[2465](#2465)            self.print_ty(ty, TypeMode::Owned);
[2468](#2468)            self.src.push_str(", ");
[2469](#2469)        }
[2470](#2470)        self.src.push_str(")| {\n");
[2471](#2471)
[2472](#2472)        if self.generator.opts.tracing {
[2473](#2473)            if let CallStyle::Async | CallStyle::Concurrent = style {
[2474](#2474)                self.src.push_str("use tracing::Instrument;\n");
[2475](#2475)            }
[2476](#2476)
[2477](#2477)            uwrite!(
[2478](#2478)                self.src,
[2479](#2479)                "
[2480](#2480)                   let span = tracing::span!(
[2481](#2481)                       tracing::Level::TRACE,
[2482](#2482)                       \"wit-bindgen import\",
[2483](#2483)                       module = \"{}\",
[2484](#2484)                       function = \"{}\",
[2485](#2485)                   );
[2486](#2486)               ",
[2487](#2487)                match owner {
[2488](#2488)                    TypeOwner::Interface(id) => self.resolve.interfaces[id]
[2489](#2489)                        .name
[2490](#2490)                        .as_deref()
[2491](#2491)                        .unwrap_or("<no module>"),
[2492](#2492)                    TypeOwner::World(id) => &self.resolve.worlds[id].name,
[2493](#2493)                    TypeOwner::None => "<no owner>",
[2494](#2494)                },
[2495](#2495)                func.name,
[2496](#2496)            );
[2497](#2497)        }
[2498](#2498)
[2499](#2499)        match &style {
[2500](#2500)            CallStyle::Async => {
[2501](#2501)                uwriteln!(
[2502](#2502)                    self.src,
[2503](#2503)                    "{wt}::component::__internal::Box::new(async move {{"
[2504](#2504)                );
[2505](#2505)            }
[2506](#2506)            CallStyle::Concurrent => {
[2507](#2507)                uwriteln!(
[2508](#2508)                    self.src,
[2509](#2509)                    "{wt}::component::__internal::Box::pin(async move {{
[2510](#2510)                        let accessor = &mut unsafe {{ caller.with_data(host_getter) }};
[2511](#2511)                    "
[2512](#2512)                );
[2513](#2513)            }
[2514](#2514)            CallStyle::Sync => {
[2515](#2515)                if self.generator.opts.tracing {
[2519](#2519)                    self.push_str("let _enter = span.enter();\n");
[2520](#2520)                }
[2521](#2521)            }
[2522](#2522)        }
[2523](#2523)
[2524](#2524)        if self.generator.opts.tracing {
[2525](#2525)            let mut event_fields = func
[2526](#2526)                .params
[2527](#2527)                .iter()
[2528](#2528)                .enumerate()
[2529](#2529)                .map(|(i, (name, ty))| {
[2530](#2530)                    let name = to_rust_ident(&name);
[2531](#2531)                    formatting_for_arg(&name, i, *ty, &self.generator.opts, &self.resolve)
[2532](#2532)                })
[2533](#2533)                .collect::<Vec<String>>();
[2534](#2534)            event_fields.push(format!("\"call\""));
[2535](#2535)            uwrite!(
[2536](#2536)                self.src,
[2537](#2537)                "tracing::event!(tracing::Level::TRACE, {});\n",
[2538](#2538)                event_fields.join(", ")
[2539](#2539)            );
[2540](#2540)        }
[2541](#2541)
[2542](#2542)        if !matches!(style, CallStyle::Concurrent) {
[2543](#2543)            self.src
[2544](#2544)                .push_str("let host = &mut host_getter(caller.data_mut());\n");
[2545](#2545)        }
[2546](#2546)        let func_name = rust_function_name(func);
[2547](#2547)        let host_trait = match func.kind.resource() {
[2548](#2548)            None => match owner {
[2549](#2549)                TypeOwner::World(id) => format!(
[2550](#2550)                    "{}Imports",
[2551](#2551)                    rust::to_rust_upper_camel_case(&self.resolve.worlds[id].name)
[2552](#2552)                ),
[2553](#2553)                _ => "Host".to_string(),
[2554](#2554)            },
[2555](#2555)            Some(id) => {
[2556](#2556)                let resource = self.resolve.types[id]
[2557](#2557)                    .name
[2558](#2558)                    .as_ref()
[2559](#2559)                    .unwrap()
[2560](#2560)                    .to_upper_camel_case();
[2561](#2561)                format!("Host{resource}")
[2562](#2562)            }
[2563](#2563)        };
[2564](#2564)
[2565](#2565)        if let CallStyle::Concurrent = &style {
[2566](#2566)            uwrite!(
[2567](#2567)                self.src,
[2568](#2568)                "let r = <D as {host_trait}Concurrent>::{func_name}(accessor, "
[2569](#2569)            );
[2570](#2570)        } else {
[2571](#2571)            uwrite!(self.src, "let r = {host_trait}::{func_name}(host, ");
[2572](#2572)        }
[2573](#2573)
[2574](#2574)        for (i, _) in func.params.iter().enumerate() {
[2575](#2575)            uwrite!(self.src, "arg{},", i);
[2576](#2576)        }
[2577](#2577)
[2578](#2578)        self.src.push_str(match &style {
[2579](#2579)            CallStyle::Sync => ");\n",
[2580](#2580)            CallStyle::Async | CallStyle::Concurrent => ").await;\n",
[2581](#2581)        });
[2582](#2582)
[2583](#2583)        if self.generator.opts.tracing {
[2584](#2584)            uwrite!(
[2585](#2585)                self.src,
[2586](#2586)                "tracing::event!(tracing::Level::TRACE, {}, \"return\");",
[2587](#2587)                formatting_for_results(func.result, &self.generator.opts, &self.resolve)
[2588](#2588)            );
[2589](#2589)        }
[2590](#2590)
[2591](#2591)        if !self.generator.opts.trappable_imports.can_trap(&func) {
[2592](#2592)            if func.result.is_some() {
[2593](#2593)                uwrite!(self.src, "Ok((r,))\n");
[2594](#2594)            } else {
[2595](#2595)                uwrite!(self.src, "Ok(r)\n");
[2596](#2596)            }
[2597](#2597)        } else if let Some((_, err, _)) = self.special_case_trappable_error(func) {
[2598](#2598)            let err = &self.resolve.types[resolve_type_definition_id(self.resolve, err)];
[2599](#2599)            let err_name = err.name.as_ref().unwrap();
[2600](#2600)            let owner = match err.owner {
[2601](#2601)                TypeOwner::Interface(i) => i,
[2602](#2602)                _ => unimplemented!(),
[2603](#2603)            };
[2604](#2604)            let convert_trait = match self.path_to_interface(owner) {
[2605](#2605)                Some(path) => format!("{path}::Host"),
[2606](#2606)                None => format!("Host"),
[2607](#2607)            };
[2608](#2608)            let convert = format!("{}::convert_{}", convert_trait, err_name.to_snake_case());
[2609](#2609)            uwrite!(
[2610](#2610)                self.src,
[2611](#2611)                "Ok((match r {{
[2612](#2612)                    Ok(a) => Ok(a),
[2613](#2613)                    Err(e) => Err({convert}(host, e)?),
[2614](#2614)                }},))"
[2615](#2615)            );
[2616](#2616)        } else if func.result.is_some() {
[2617](#2617)            uwrite!(self.src, "Ok((r?,))\n");
[2618](#2618)        } else {
[2619](#2619)            uwrite!(self.src, "r\n");
[2620](#2620)        }
[2621](#2621)
[2622](#2622)        match &style {
[2623](#2623)            CallStyle::Sync => (),
[2624](#2624)            CallStyle::Async | CallStyle::Concurrent => {
[2625](#2625)                if self.generator.opts.tracing {
[2626](#2626)                    self.src.push_str("}.instrument(span))\n");
[2627](#2627)                } else {
[2628](#2628)                    self.src.push_str("})\n");
[2629](#2629)                }
[2630](#2630)            }
[2631](#2631)        }
[2632](#2632)
[2633](#2633)        self.src.push_str("}\n");
[2634](#2634)    }
[2635](#2635)
[2636](#2636)    fn generate_function_trait_sig(&mut self, func: &Function, async_sugar: bool) {
[2637](#2637)        let wt = self.generator.wasmtime_path();
[2638](#2638)        self.rustdoc(&func.docs);
[2639](#2639)
[2640](#2640)        let style = self.import_call_style(func);
[2641](#2641)        if let (CallStyle::Async, _) | (CallStyle::Concurrent, true) = (&style, async_sugar) {
[2642](#2642)            self.push_str("async ");
[2643](#2643)        }
[2644](#2644)        self.push_str("fn ");
[2645](#2645)        self.push_str(&rust_function_name(func));
[2646](#2646)        self.push_str(&if let CallStyle::Concurrent = &style {
[2647](#2647)            format!("<T: 'static>(accessor: &mut {wt}::component::Accessor<T, Self>, ")
[2648](#2648)        } else {
[2649](#2649)            "(&mut self, ".to_string()
[2650](#2650)        });
[2651](#2651)        self.generate_function_params(func);
[2652](#2652)        self.push_str(")");
[2653](#2653)        self.push_str(" -> ");
[2654](#2654)
[2655](#2655)        if let (CallStyle::Concurrent, false) = (&style, async_sugar) {
[2656](#2656)            uwrite!(self.src, "impl ::core::future::Future<Output = ");
[2657](#2657)        }
[2658](#2658)
[2659](#2659)        self.generate_function_result(func);
[2660](#2660)
[2661](#2661)        if let CallStyle::Concurrent = style {
[2662](#2662)            if !async_sugar {
[2663](#2663)                self.push_str("> + Send where Self: Sized,");
[2664](#2664)            }
[2665](#2665)        }
[2666](#2666)    }
[2667](#2667)
[2668](#2668)    fn generate_function_params(&mut self, func: &Function) {
[2669](#2669)        for (name, param) in func.params.iter() {
[2670](#2670)            let name = to_rust_ident(name);
[2671](#2671)            self.push_str(&name);
[2672](#2672)            self.push_str(": ");
[2673](#2673)            self.print_ty(param, TypeMode::Owned);
[2674](#2674)            self.push_str(",");
[2675](#2675)        }
[2676](#2676)    }
[2677](#2677)
[2678](#2678)    fn generate_function_result(&mut self, func: &Function) {
[2679](#2679)        if !self.generator.opts.trappable_imports.can_trap(func) {
[2680](#2680)            self.print_result_ty(func.result, TypeMode::Owned);
[2681](#2681)        } else if let Some((r, _id, error_typename)) = self.special_case_trappable_error(func) {
[2682](#2682)            self.push_str("Result<");
[2686](#2686)            if let Some(ok) = r.ok {
[2687](#2687)                self.print_ty(&ok, TypeMode::Owned);
[2688](#2688)            } else {
[2689](#2689)                self.push_str("()");
[2690](#2690)            }
[2691](#2691)            self.push_str(",");
[2692](#2692)            self.push_str(&error_typename);
[2693](#2693)            self.push_str(">");
[2694](#2694)        } else {
[2695](#2695)            let wt = self.generator.wasmtime_path();
[2698](#2698)            uwrite!(self.src, "{wt}::Result<");
[2699](#2699)            self.print_result_ty(func.result, TypeMode::Owned);
[2700](#2700)            self.push_str(">");
[2701](#2701)        }
[2702](#2702)    }
[2703](#2703)
[2704](#2704)    fn extract_typed_function(&mut self, func: &Function) -> (String, String) {
[2705](#2705)        let snake = func_field_name(self.resolve, func);
[2706](#2706)        let sig = self.typedfunc_sig(func, TypeMode::AllBorrowed("'_"));
[2707](#2707)        let extract =
[2708](#2708)            format!("*_instance.get_typed_func::<{sig}>(&mut store, &self.{snake})?.func()");
[2709](#2709)        (snake, extract)
[2710](#2710)    }
